name: Jennifer Campbell
tagline: Top rated Products Liability attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Jennifer Campbell is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - Products: Defense, Personal Injury - General: Defense and Appellate.

Jennifer Campbell, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Seattle University School of Law. She graduated in 2001. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2001.
